id: title:Gilbert09:give unpartitioned repartition targets an md5 bucket count

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion and rewrite reliability: P1.F1.H2 adds a computed partition count to prevent warehouse rewrite failures and OOMs when no supported partition mode is detected; P1.F2.H2 adds a regression test for the UUID-only fallback path.
review.reason: Adds a computed partition_count to the returned RepartitionTarget when no supported partition mode is detected, and adds a test for the UUID-only fallback path.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a substantive implementation and a corresponding regression test. The exact operational benefit depends on warehouse compatibility and the frequency of UUID-only primary keys, which are not established by this code alone. No production incident or adoption is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a computed partition_count to the returned RepartitionTarget when no supported partition mode is detected, and adds a test for the UUID-only fallback path.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents warehouse rewrite failures for tables with UUID primary keys and no datetime columns, which previously failed with 'No supported partition mode' and could cause OOM on merge. The computed count enables the md5 fallback path.

observations.behavior: Updates the expected result in a unit test to include the newly added partition_count field.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a regression test for the specific failure mode: a UUID primary key without a datetime column, which previously caused warehouse rewrite failures and potential OOM. This test verifies the md5 fallback behavior.
